content_record.editorial_body: A new review maps the cellular remodelling of fat tissue with age, linking senescent cells and immune shifts to disease risk, and weighs interventions from caloric restriction to senolytics. Three things to remember - Ageing remodels fat tissue: adipocyte hypertrophy, progenitor exhaustion, immune infiltration. - Senescent cells in fat secrete SASP factors, driving chronic inflammation and insulin resistance. - Caloric restriction, metformin, GLP-1 agonists, senolytics may counter adipose ageing. Source This signal is based on Adipose tissue ageing: implications for metabolic health and lifespan. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context. Health note: Review article; mechanisms and intervention efficacy not quantified in primary data.
